confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Kathmandu tourist-area pricing; no live menus, listings or rates were checked. Meal and beer anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation varies widely, and July is monsoon low season, so rooms may sit below these levels. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor because direct knowledge was weaker. Beer reflects a bottled domestic beer because draft is uncommon locally. The FX figure comes from an RBA search result; the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. The regional basis is South Asian tourist-district pricing, anchored to Kathmandu's backpacker and mid-range market.
